one_line: Yogācāra Buddhist philosopher of Vallabhi, c. 6th century CE.

appearance.face: oval face, medium wheat-brown complexion, thoughtful almond-shaped eyes with slightly heavy lids, straight medium nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, calm focused expression with a hint of gentle curiosity
appearance.hair: straight black hair, medium length, combed back and tied into a small low knot at the nape; simple narrow white cotton headband circling the forehead, no ornament
appearance.costume: era-accurate Buddhist scholar attire: a saffron-yellow cotton under-robe covering torso and legs, over which is draped a plain ochre-brown kāṣāya-style patchwork robe from left shoulder down, leaving the right shoulder modestly covered by a soft off-white cotton shawl; under-robe visible as long sleeves at the wrists and as a narrow hem at the ankles; simple dark brown leather sandals; no jewelry except a small wooden mala wrapped twice around the left wrist, garments slightly worn but clean and orderly
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin red cord, held in his left hand, with a single loose palm leaf marked by a dark wooden stylus in his right hand.

ref_desc: Sthiramati is a lean mid-30s Yogācāra scholar with wheat-brown skin, short black hair in a low knot and white headband, wearing saffron-yellow under-robe, ochre-brown kāṣāya with off-white shawl, dark brown sandals, wooden wrist mala, and holding palm-leaf manuscripts bound by a red cord with stylus.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Sthiramati, a 6th-century Vallabhi Buddhist philosopher: mid-30s, lean build, wheat-brown complexion, oval face, thoughtful almond eyes, short black hair combed back into a small low knot, and a simple narrow white cotton headband. He wears a saffron-yellow cotton under-robe that covers his torso, arms, and legs to the ankles, overlaid by an ochre-brown kāṣāya-style monk’s robe draped from the left shoulder down in modest patchwork folds, with a soft off-white shawl covering his right shoulder and arm. His long sleeves and the narrow hem of the under-robe show at wrists and ankles, and he stands in simple dark brown leather sandals. A small wooden mala wraps twice around his left wrist. In his left hand he holds a rolled palm-leaf manuscript tied with a thin red cord, while his right hand carries a single loose palm leaf and a dark wooden stylus, suggesting active commentary. Show him in neutral, calm, gently focused poses from front, side, and back views with consistent colors—saffron yellow, ochre brown, off-white, dark brown, and the touch of red cord—so the face, hair knot, robes, shawl, wrist mala, sandals, and manuscript prop can be redrawn identically across panels.
